summary: The9 Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing that its AI-developed mobile simulation game, The Greed of Man, reached No. 1 in the Simulation Games category on both the Hong Kong Apple App Store and Google Play after its September 24, 2026 launch. The title was built on the9bit, The9's proprietary AI game production platform, and is based on licensed intellectual property from Television Broadcasts Limited. Management cited an approximately eight-month development cycle versus the traditional two-to-three years, and plans a mainland China launch. No transaction, securities offering, or special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine operational update.
